brief: Original 30-second Hindi motion study using the supplied coaching reference's cream/orange treatment.

options: Coin emerging beside an original chai cart
Receipt tearing into a question mark
beats.chosen: Cart, cup and expressive coin establish the unit and question.
beats.picture: Left original wood cart; right clay cup and ₹20 coin; coin's expression becomes worried.
beats.motion: Masked words, prop entry with damped overshoot, small coin drift and readable hold.
beats.camera: Small scale drift; short lateral scene exit.
beats.sound: One wood contact and one light coin ping.

beats.chosen: A hundred cups build into price × volume and ₹2,000.
beats.picture: 10×10 cup grid at left, original receipt at right.
beats.motion: Repeated units populate; count and total use the same eased volume.
beats.sound: Paper move, soft musical plucks, total ping.

beats.chosen: Four legible cards show milk, leaves, sugar and cup at 5+1+1+1.
beats.picture: Four original ingredient illustrations over warm paper.
beats.motion: Staggered entries and count settle before the total.
beats.sound: Short soft contacts; one final total ping.

options: Cost pieces split a conserved revenue bar
beats.chosen: Keep ₹800 visible, grow a ₹500 overhead section, shrink ₹1,200 to ₹700.
beats.picture: One 2000-wide proportional bar with 800/500/700 amounts; overhead receipt.
beats.motion: Cost occupies 25% of bar; remainder conserves total.

beats.chosen: ₹700 coin and explicit owner labour/tax/setup exclusions.
beats.picture: Original smiling orange coin; one equation card; red labour note.
beats.motion: Coin settles, exclusions appear after the headline.
beats.sound: Warm coin ping, ducked music under speech.

options: Return to cart with two price tags
beats.chosen: Two cards make revenue and remainder visibly different, closing on a useful question.
beats.text: Kharch kaatkar kitna bacha? Bikri suno. Hisaab bhi poochho.
beats.motion: Stagger cards and inequality; settle for final read.
beats.sound: Last light paper/coin accents; music fades through final second.
